title: Senior Product Manager, Fulfilment
jd_excerpt:
About Nivoda
 Nivoda is the operating system for the global jewellery industry. Our marketplace connects jewellers with suppliers of diamonds, gemstones, melee and finished jewellery in 70+ countries, with more than $300M in annual transactions and a $350B industry still waiting to be modernised. We are scaling fast, and we are only getting started.
 Our Mission
 For decades, the diamond trade has been slow, opaque and inefficient: hard to find stock, hard to trust prices, hard to know when anything will arrive. Nivoda exists to change that. We give businesses of every size, in every location, the same access to inventory, the same transparent pricing and the same reliable delivery as the biggest players in the industry.
 The Fulfilment & Express Team
 The Fulfilment & Express team is where Nivoda's promise to buyers is kept. We own how an order travels from supplier to jeweller: the delivery date we promise, the hubs that hold and check stock, the carriers that move it, and the returns and quality checks that protect every purchase. We are a remote-first team of product, engineering, design and QA who work closely with Operations, Customer Support, Sales and Supplier Experience. We are low on hierarchy and high on ownership, and we like solving problems where software meets the physical world.
 About the Role
 As our Senior Product Manager for Fulfilment & Express, you will own how Nivoda orders get from supplier to jeweller: accurately promised, reliably tracked and delivered fast. You will set the strategy and roadmap for a complex, operationally heavy product area that spans diamonds, gemstones, melee and finished jewellery, with physical hubs, carriers and suppliers behind every screen. Your work decides whether a jeweller trusts Nivoda with their next order, so this is a role with real commercial impact and plenty of room to lead.
 What would YOU be doing?
 Setting the fulfilment strategy for the next 2 to 4 quarters, making trade-offs explicit, including what we are choosing not to do and why
 Owning the roadmap and the numbers: running quarterly planning, sizing opportunities and setting targets for delivery-as-promised, delivery date accuracy and delivery speed
 Making our Promised Delivery Dates trustworthy by rolling out SLA-based, dynamic delivery dates across every category and route, and shaping how they are used for delay communications and, in time, shown to buyers
 Scaling Express, our hub-based fast-delivery offer, including hub workflows (receiving, inventory and RFID put/pick, QC and dispatch), ready-to-wear jewellery, consignment flows and speed options such as same-day pickup
 Owning jewellery returns and on-platform QC, from the manufacturer through to the hub, including hallmarking and consignment returns to suppliers
 Improving the delivery experience through carrier and rate/transit integrations, consolidation, last-mile cost and efficiency, and clear order visibility for buyers
 Translating hub operations, carrier behaviour, customs and supplier handling into clear product requirements, designing for the exceptions as much as the happy path
 Turning support tickets, delay breaches, supplier performance data and customer feedback into prioritised problems, then deciding what to build, buy or fix operationally
 Partnering daily with Engineering and Design, and closely with Operations, Customer Support, Account Management, Sales, Supplier Experience and Fintech so delivery, credit and payments feel like one journey for the buyer
 Writing sharp PRDs and decision records, and reporting progress openly through our weekly updates
 Mentoring other product managers and designers on working in operationally complex domains
 What do we need from YOU?
 5 to 8 years in product management, including experience owning a complex product area end to end
 Experience in fulfilment, logistics, supply chain or other operations-heavy products. You are comfortable where software meets warehouses, carriers, SLAs and customs
 Strong systems thinking: you can map a multi-party process, find where promises break, and design for failure modes, delays and edge cases
 Data fluency: you define the right metrics, query and interrogate data yourself (Snowflake, Mixpanel or similar) and use it to decide what to build next
 Sound prioritisation and commercial judgement: you weigh impact, effort and risk honestly, say no clearly, and can explain the return on a fulfilment investment to leadership
 Excellent cross-functional leadership: you build trust with engineers, operators and commercial teams, and influence without authority across time zones
 Clear written communication: concise PRDs, roadmaps and updates that make decisions easy
 Customer and operator empathy, and high agency: you spend time with jewellers, support teams and hub operators, you take ownership, and you follow things through to the outcome
 Nice to have
 Jewellery, diamond or luxury goods experience
 Marketplace or B2B commerce experience, ideally two-sided with supply and demand constraints
 Experience with carrier or shipping APIs, rate and transit tools, 3PL integrations, inventory systems or RFID
 Experience building predictive or SLA-based estimates, such as delivery dates or ETAs
 Experience with cross-border shipping, customs, duties or compliance (for example hallmarking and HS codes)
Our culture and what we offer
 Nivoda is collaborative, high-growth and built on empowerment. You will have real ownership from day one, a team that wants you to succeed, and the chance to keep learning as the company scales. We are remote-first with flexible hours, and we trust you to do your best work your way.
Our current benefits
 ⏰ Flexible working hours and a vibrant company culture
 🏡 Remote work
 🩺 Private health insurance
 📚 Opportunities for growth and learning
 💳 Flexible compensation card (meals, transport, childcare)
 🌴 Unlimited holiday allowance
 🚀 The chance to join during an exponential expansion phase
